requirements.description: Find the first non-printable ASCII character lazily with a generator, without materializing a list

label.evidence: httpx/_urlparse.py:163 now uses next(char for char in url if char.isascii() and not char.isprintable()). The same fix is applied at httpx/_urlparse.py:213-215.
label.notes: the author's reply says it "can be done lazily by materializing a generator", which is loosely worded. The code uses next() over a generator expression, which is not materialized. The any(...) guard on line 162 means next() always finds a match, so there is no StopIteration risk.
